prompts.hostile-on-map:
Hostiles are on the map and nobody is drafted.
Look first: game_list_colonists (who is armed) and game_take_screenshot of the threatened side.
Sequence: game_pause_game -> game_set_draft each armed pawn -> order_pawn each to the tile right behind an embrasure facing the enemy -> game_set_time_speed 1.
If order_pawn refuses a cell, pick the next embrasure along the same wall; never stand in the open.
Done = drafted_count > 0 (raid-posted takes over).
Owner: "remmebr always field tnde directly brefopre cpature and haul".
prompts.raid-posted:
The line is posted.
Look first: alert_bleeding / downed_count and the fight frame.
Sequence: keep posts; turret force-target on sappers via game_execute_gizmo; downed pawn -> order_pawn a doctor to tend in place, then carry.
If a pawn is flanked, order_pawn to the next embrasure, not into the open.
Done = hostiles_on_map 0 (raid-cleanup).
Owner: "charge them but keep ur distance from them in gun range" / "save scar!!!!".
prompts.raid-cleanup:
Fight is over.
Sequence: game_set_draft off -> tend + capture downed raiders (prisoner bed) -> haul corpses out -> repairs.
If capture refuses (no prisoner bed), build one now with game_set cmd beds then set_bed_owner prisoner.
Done = drafted_count 0 and corpses <= CORPSE_LIMIT.
Owner: "Prisoner bed exists BEFORE any fight".
prompts.prisoner-bed-before-fight:
A threat letter is live and there is no prisoner bed.
Sequence: game_set cmd beds -> game_set cmd set_bed_owner (that bed's x z) owner prisoner -> ladder_set mark prisoner_bed true.
If beds refuses (no room), game_set cmd shelter first, then retry once.
Done = mark_prisoner_bed true.
Owner: "Prisoner bed exists BEFORE any fight".

Something is damaged and the map is clear.

Done = buildings_damaged 0 (defense-0-reset-damage clears secure).
Owner: "no u need to fix the whole wall".
